name: IMO-Bench
intro: IMO-Bench 是由数学奥赛奖牌得主与数学家构建的三能力评测套件。论文快照包含 400 题的 IMO-AnswerBench、60 题的 IMO-ProofBench 和 1,000 条带专家分数的 IMO-GradingBench，分别评估短答案正确性、证明质量以及模型评价证明的能力；三条分支使用不同的输入上下文和指标。
build_method: 奖牌得主与数学家筛选、原创和稳健化题目，并由专家按 IMO 0–7 分制标注
metric: Answer accuracy; proof percent of maximum points; grading accuracy and MAE
task_type: 数学简答、证明生成、证明评分
eval_feature: 专家评分、语义答案评分、评分器验证
scale: 400 道简答题 + 60 道证明题 + 1,000 条评分样本
task_type_en: Mathematical short answers, proof generation, and proof grading
build_method_en: Medalist and mathematician problem selection, authoring and robustification, with expert IMO-style 0–7 grading
eval_feature_en: Expert proof grading, semantic answer grading, and grader validation
intro_en: IMO-Bench is a three-capability evaluation suite built by mathematics Olympiad medalists and mathematicians. The paper snapshot contains the 400-item IMO-AnswerBench, 60-item IMO-ProofBench, and 1,000-item IMO-GradingBench, separately evaluating short-answer correctness, proof quality, and the ability to grade proofs. Each branch uses a different evaluation context and metric.
scale_en: 400 answer problems + 60 proof problems + 1,000 grading samples
metric_en: Answer accuracy; proof percent of maximum points; grading accuracy and MAE

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2511.01846v1, the paper release at google-deepmind/superhuman commit 92ae8c2e88dee12a3f793dd88a5e80ed76754c2a, and current project snapshot 96fa6c4cc3a9bb7450ee7b6773b659d3a030dace. The paper defines three parallel benchmarks rather than a sequential pipeline. IMO-AnswerBench contains 400 robustified, verifiable short-answer problems and uses Gemini 2.5 Pro AnswerAutoGrader for final-answer semantic equivalence. IMO-ProofBench contains 60 proof problems, split into 30 Basic and 30 Advanced; the Advanced set comprises 18 novel medalist-authored problems, 6 robustified IMO 2024 problems, and 6 USAMO 2025 problems. Human experts receive the problem, candidate solution, reference solution, and specific grading guidelines and assign integer 0–7 grades; percentages of maximum points based on human grades are the primary proof result, while ProofAutoGrader is only a scalable proxy. IMO-GradingBench contains 1,000 solutions to the 30 advanced problems with expert 0–7 scores. Evaluation maps human scores into buckets 7 / 6-4 / 3-1 / 0, provides models only the problem and proposed solution, parses the last word first with an LLM fallback, and reports four-way accuracy plus MAE using predicted scores 7/6/1/0. Commits ea72dda6e4aa615d940cf84713b142bcb0aa75b5 and 955558ad67ef24dccd27545c326988bdad1b4471 define the corrected answerbench_v2 lineage. The current project later adds IMO-LeanProofBench, which is excluded from this paper-snapshot diagram; the paper benchmark assets are CSV-only.
